scope: Target CI (verify, deploy, verify-published) and deployed-candidate evidence for isolated child-process numerical verification of the published bundle
isolationIntroducedIn: a1494e2 (2026-10-15T10:21:37+09:00); ancestor of every cited head
mechanism: scripts/check-published.mjs runs each deployed numerical task via runPublishedProcess (scripts/published-process-runtime.mjs): fork of same executable, one IPC request, result provisional until child close with code 0, timeout/malformed IPC/duplicate or late messages/native fatal diagnostics rejected. CI proves it in verify-published job after deploy.
ciLogNote: CI logs print per-check PASS lines and a summary line only; the child-process phases are not printed. Isolation is evidenced by the check-published code path being the run command plus the pass/zero-fail result, not by dedicated isolation log lines.
